answer.book: Second tome of Francisci Burmanni Synopsis theologiae (Liber V to VIII, the economy of the New Testament), built as Liber, Locus and Caput, with the separate work Consilium de studio theologico feliciter instituendo appended (Caput I to III), a printed conspectus at the front and two indexes (locorum and rerum) at the back.
